1.t: When the earth is shaken ˹in˺ its ultimate quaking

2.t: and when the earth throws out ˹all˺ its contents

3.t: and humanity cries, “What is wrong with it?”—

4.t: on that Day the earth will recount everything

5.t: having been inspired by your Lord ˹to do so˺

6.t: On that Day people will proceed in separate groups to be shown ˹the consequences of˺ their deeds
6.tr: Yawma-iziny yas-durun naasu ash-tatal liyuraw a'maalahum

7.t: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it
7.tr: Famaiy ya'mal mithqala zarratin khai-raiy yarah

8.t: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it
8.tr: Wa-maiy y'amal mithqala zarratin sharraiy yarah
